summary: Elbit Systems Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held August 5, 2026. The filing is a routine corporate governance update, including election of board members, re-election of an external director, extension of indemnification/exemption letters, and re-appointment of auditors. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing is a standard meeting outcome notice under Form 6-K for a foreign private issuer, with no financial terms, deal structure, or unusual actions warranting classification as a special situation.
